title: 第一卷 第25章 你怎么没死第一卷 第26章 丹侍
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 曹阳看着范建满脸的横肉，心中冷笑。
这狗东西真是巴不得自己去死是吧？
不过面上，他还是要表现出一副虚弱的样子。
“我运气比较好，走到毒障沟边缘的时候，遇到一阵怪风，那片区域的毒瘴被吹散了不少，我在里面躲了一宿，这才侥幸捡回一条命。”
范建眼角剧烈抽动着。
怪风？
吹散毒瘴？
这是什么逆天运气？
他本来不想相信的，可曹阳全须全尾地站在这里，毫发无损，由不得他不信。
范建心里极度不爽。
他原本以为曹阳必死无疑，自己还能顺手牵羊，去曹阳那间破茅草屋里看看有没有遗产。
本来昨晚就该去的，却被事情耽误了，现在刚想去，曹阳又回来了。
真是造孽。
“运气倒是不错。”范建冷哼一声，眼底闪过一丝阴狠。
既然没死，那就再送你去死一次。
“西边废料坑深处还有一批陈年毒渣没清理，今天这个任务交给你了。”
曹阳目光一沉。
西边废料坑常年堆积剧毒废料。
那里的毒性比毒障沟也是不遑多让。
这范建就这么想让自己死？
曹阳看了他一会儿，琢磨着要不要直接一不做二不休。
范建虽然和被曹阳杀死的那只枯木妖王一样，也是炼气五层。
不过人和妖终归是不同的。
人可比妖阴险多了。
不过曹阳现在是炼气四层中期，如果加上张娴雅的话，以有心算无心应该能够悄无声息地做掉他。
只是瞒得了一时瞒不了一世，做得再隐蔽也很容易暴露的。
就在曹阳权衡利弊的时候，范建腰间的传讯符忽然亮了起来。
拿起之后，脸上立刻带起了舔狗般的笑容，声音更是温柔无比。
“娴雅，你有什么吩咐？”
那头传来张娴雅冷淡的声音，“我已经正式晋升一阶炼丹师了，现在需要挑选一名丹侍，你组织一下人手，带到我院子前。”
“没问题，娴雅放心，马上就到。”范建连连点头。
结束通讯后，他心中也不禁在思索。
这不就是讨好张娴雅的现成事情吗？
必须把这次挑丹侍的事情办得漂漂亮亮。
把排场搞大，展现出自己在杂役中的绝对威信。
组织的人手越多，场面越大，越能显示出自己的能力。
content_en:
Cao Yang looked at Fan Jian's face and sneered in his heart.
This bitch really wants to die, right?
But on the surface, he still had to show a weak look.
"I was lucky. When I walked to the edge of the Poison Barrier Ditch, I encountered a strange gust of wind. The poisonous miasma in that area was blown away a lot. I hid in it for the whole night, and then I was lucky enough to save my life."
The corners of Fan Jian's eyes twitched violently.
Weird wind?
Blow away the poisonous miasma?
What kind of bad luck is this?
He didn't want to believe it at first, but Cao Yang was standing here with his head intact, unscathed, so he couldn't help but not believe it.
Fan Jian felt extremely unhappy.
He originally thought that Cao Yang would definitely die, but he could still take advantage of it and go to Cao Yang's thatched thatched house to see if there was any inheritance.
I was supposed to go last night, but I was delayed by something. Now I was just about to go, but Cao Yang came back again.
What a crime.
"You're lucky." Fan Jian snorted coldly, with a hint of evil flashing in his eyes.
Since you are not dead, I will send you to death again.
"There is still a batch of old poisonous residue deep in the waste pit to the west that has not been cleaned up. This task is left to you today."
Cao Yang's eyes darkened.
The waste pit in the west accumulates highly toxic waste all year round.
The toxicity there is no less than that of the Poison Barrage Ditch.
Does Fan Jian really want to die?
Cao Yang looked at him for a while, wondering whether he should just stop doing it.
Although Fan Jian was at the fifth level of Qi refining just like the withered wood demon king killed by Cao Yang.
But humans and demons are different after all.
Humans are much more insidious than demons.
However, Cao Yang is currently in the middle stage of the fourth level of Qi Refining. If Zhang Xianya is included, he should be able to kill him quietly with mental arithmetic but no intention.
It's just that you can't hide it for a while, and no matter how concealed it is, it will be easily exposed.
Just as Cao Yang was weighing the pros and cons, the communication talisman around Fan Jian's waist suddenly lit up.
After picking it up, a dog-licking smile immediately appeared on his face, and his voice was extremely gentle.
"Xianya, what are your orders?"
Zhang Xianya's cold voice came from the other end, "I have been officially promoted to a first-level alchemist. Now I need to select an alchemy attendant. You can organize the people and bring them to my courtyard."
"No problem, don't worry Xianya, we'll be there soon." Fan Jian nodded repeatedly.
After ending the communication, he couldn't help but think about it.
Isn't this just a ready-made thing to please Zhang Xianya?
We must handle the selection of Dan Shi this time beautifully.
Make the scene grand and show your absolute authority among the handymen.
The more manpower an organization has and the bigger the scene, the more it can demonstrate its capabilities.
